You’re on version v1.2.0. v1.2.0 v1.1.0 v1.0.0 v1.2.0 Nov 15, 2026 Latest Supervised AI automation AI can now suggest work and carry out what you approve: customer texts, notes and follow-ups, each checked and recorded. Nothing reaches a customer or touches money until a person approves the exact wording. NEW AI approval inbox AI operations shows every AI proposal with its exact wording, recipient, amount and history. Approve or reject it there; done, failed and rejected items have their own tabs. NEW Decide from ChatGPT ChatGPT can propose actions and list, review, approve or reject proposals (propose_action, list_proposals, get_proposal, approve_proposal, reject_proposal). Contracts, estimates, purchases, refunds, price changes and cancellations are approved in Volteira only. NEW Automatic follow-ups New website requests, signed contracts and finished jobs with no invoice add a follow-up to the job or customer. Overdue invoices and low stock put a proposal in the inbox. NEW Approved customer texts go out on their own Once approved, a text is sent within seconds, checked first for the customer's texting consent, an unchanged number and quiet hours. Delivery shows in Messages. IMPROVED Invoice reminders stay accurate An approved overdue-invoice reminder is checked against the invoice right before sending.
